groups.name: Bishops Point (First Come, First Served)
groups.description:
First Come, First Served. 

$15.00 a night.

Bishop's Point is located off of Natrona County Road 409 Pathfinder Road and Bishop Road. Campground information and pay boxes are located at multiple kiosks along the roadside of each Natrona County Park.

Bishop's Point has sheltered and non-sheltered campsites. The campground also has a high water and low water boat ramps allowing full access to the reservoir at all times. This makes Bishop's Point a popular fishing and boating area.

Please note that water levels vary greatly at Pathfinder Reservoir. Campsites may be at the waters' edge one year and 1,500 feet away from the water another year.

Please Note: The Wildlife Preserve Area is Day Use Only. Camping is Not Allowed. 

Directions to Bishop's Point Campground

groups.name: Diabase
groups.description:
Reservation Only. Diabase is located off of Natrona County Road 409 to the west of Pathfinder Dam. Newly improved in 2023 Diabase Campground features 40' long concrete pads, 12' shelters, fire rings and picnic tables at each out of 11 sites. Restroom facilities are available. 

There are 2 ADA accessible campsites with beautiful views. Diabase campground is located closest to the boat ramp, dock, and the Pathfinder Marina. Water levels vary greatly at Pathfinder Reservoir. Campsites may be at the waters' edge one year and 1,500 feet away from the water another year. 

$13.39 a day plus taxes and fees. 

Directions To Diabase Campground

groups.name: Wolf Point (First Come, First Served)
groups.description:
First Come, First Served. 

$15.00 a night. 

Wolf Point Primitive Camping area is located across the bay from the marina and campgrounds to the southwest of the Pathfinder dam area off of Cardwell Road. Campground information and pay boxes are located at multiple kiosks along the roadside of each Natrona County Park.

Wolf Point has open dry camping with no designated developed camp sites but restroom facilities are available. 

The road to Wolf Point is steep and can be rough traveling at times. This location is not recommended for those who like to have people or services near by. Four wheel drive vehicles are also recommended for this area. There are no boat ramps or docks in this area.

Please note that water levels vary greatly at Pathfinder Reservoir. Campsites may be at the waters' edge one year and 1,500 feet away from the water another year.

Directions to Wolf Point Campground
